scope: Reconcile the InternVL training figure in chapter 64c (RU and EN). Preserve the historical InternVL 2.5 recipe and original link, retire its raster from publication, and compare it with the documented joint pre-training of InternVL 3 and 3.5.

review.sources: Chen et al. arXiv:2412.05271v1, §§3.2–3.3, Table 3 and Figure 4; Zhu et al. arXiv:2504.10479v1, §§2.2 and 3.14; Wang et al. arXiv:2508.18265v1, §§2.1–2.3, Table 1 and Figure 3.
review.worked_case: Follow the car-color response error: stage 1 backpropagates through frozen LLM to MLP; 1.5 additionally updates ViT while keeping LLM frozen; stage 2 updates all three on instruction data. The paper's 26B versus 78B recipes illustrate reusing the adapted ViT while re-fitting the projector. Joint pre-training starts with pretrained ViT/LLM weights and permits all three to change from the first multimodal stage. Visual embeddings are conditioning inputs, not target IDs.
review.style: Read the full RU and EN chapter before editing. Keep the concrete gradient example, separate architecture from training stages and distinguish token counts from RL sample counts. Original code, other figures and the older section anchor are preserved.
review.rights: InternVL 2.5 Figure 4 is a direct link to the pinned source PDF; the original archived crop remains hash-pinned and unpublished. InternVL 3.5 Figure 3 is the exact arXiv PNG and its specific version states CC BY 4.0. This does not establish republication rights for the other VLM training figures.

Chapter checker ran the eight Python blocks twice and verified the ten embedded figures against the previous inventory and the source repair records. Chrome at 1280, 375 and 320 px in RU/EN confirmed the full stage table, inline figure and attribution without horizontal overflow. At 375 px, 4× zoom and pan were checked. Both Flash links reach the corresponding resolution-router section. No commit, push or deployment.

### Три этапа InternVL и перенос зрительного encoder

В [InternVL 2.5, §3.2–3.3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.05271v1)
начальный MLP warmup обучает projector при замороженных ViT и LLM.
Следующий, необязательный этап 1.5 обучает ViT вместе с projector,
оставляя LLM замороженной. На последнем этапе обновляется вся модель.

![[02 Areas/ML & DL/00 Учебник/Assets/Figures/curated/vlm-2026/internvl25-figure4-training-pipeline.png]]

*Zhe Chen et al., [InternVL 2.5, Figure 4](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.05271v1),
PDF p. 6. Панель (a) показывает три набора обучаемых компонентов.
В панели (b) уже дообученный InternViT используется с более крупной
LLM; для новой пары снова обучается projector.*

Например, ViT можно адаптировать с меньшей языковой моделью, затем

Заморозка и скорость обучения задаются отдельно. ### InternVL 3 и 3.5: совместное обучение с первого этапа [InternVL 3, §2.2](https://arxiv.org/html/2504.10479v1#S2.SS2) начинает мультимодальное предобучение с совместного обновления ViT, проектора и LLM. В смесь входят тексты без изображений и мультимодальные примеры. Этот порядок сохранился в [InternVL 3.5, §2.1–2.2](https://arxiv.org/html/2508.18265v1#S2.SS2). Авторы начинают с уже предобученных зрительного энкодера и LLM: `native` здесь означает, что их обучают вместе с первого мультимодального этапа, а не инициализируют случайными весами. ![[02 Areas/ML & DL/00 Учебник/Assets/Figures/curated/vlm-training-2026-11-13/internvl35-training-process.png|Слева направо: совместное предобучение, SFT, Cascade RL. Версия Flash получает дополнительный этап ViCO для работы с разной степенью сжатия изображения.]] *Weiyun Wang et al., [InternVL3.5, рис. 3](https://arxiv.org/html/2508.18265v1#S2.F3), [оригинал PNG](https://arxiv.org/html/2508.18265v1/training_process.png), [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Без изменений.* В первом блоке схемы на примере с машиной ошибка текстового ответа уже может менять веса всех трёх компонентов. Визуальные векторы при этом остаются входом: модель предсказывает текст, а в диалогах ошибку считают по токенам ответа. Во втором блоке, SFT, цель сохраняется, а данные сменяются отобранными диалогами. Подписи `250B tokens` и `130B tokens` относятся к этим этапам; `270K samples` под Cascade RL считает примеры, а не токены. Последний блок ViCO нужен только для [[00 Учебник/16 Multimodal Models/64b Разрешение, tiling и пространственные позиции#vlm-internvl-resolution-router|варианта Flash с выбором разрешения]]. В [абляции InternVL 3, §3.14 и рис. 3](https://arxiv.org/html/2504.10479v1#S3.SS14) авторы оставили архитектуру, исходные веса и данные InternVL2-8B прежними, а отдельный прогрев MLP заменили совместным предобучением. На большинстве показанных задач результат уже после предобучения сопоставим с двухэтапной базовой моделью; последующее дообучение на инструкциях улучшило его. Это сравнение двух расписаний для InternVL2-8B, а не замер выигрыша между релизами 2.5 и 3.5.

changes.old: Connector-only training leaves the original vision and language weights unchanged and avoids their weight gradients and optimizer state. It can still require LLM activations for input gradients. If the encoder output lacks the information needed for OCR, the projector cannot invent it; unfreezing vision allows those features to change. Changing the LLM can adapt how it uses visual inputs, but may degrade previous abilities. Retention must be measured on text-only and other preserved tasks, not inferred from the freeze schedule. InternVL makes the schedule explicit: warm up the MLP with frozen backbones, optionally adapt the ViT, then perform full-model instruction tuning. ![[02 Areas/ML & DL/00 Учебник/Assets/Figures/curated/vlm-2026/internvl25-figure4-training-pipeline.png]] *Figure 4 from Zhe Chen et al., [InternVL 2.5](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.05271), PDF p. 6. Panel (a) shows the trainable components; panel (b) transfers an adapted InternViT to a larger LLM and trains a new projector.* Stage 1.5 trains vision and projector while freezing the LLM; its optional use concerns reuse of an already adapted vision encoder, not arbitrary removal of perception training. Moving that encoder from a smaller to a larger language model requires realigning the connector to the new width and input space. Molmo makes a different choice: [§4](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.17146v2) omits a connector-only warmup and trains all components directly on PixMo-Cap. The connector uses learning rate $2\cdot10^{-4}$ with 200 warmup steps, the ViT $6\cdot10^{-6}$ and LLM $2\cdot10^{-5}$ with 2000 warmup steps each. InternVL 2.5 instead uses one learning rate across the model during full instruction tuning. Neither recipe can be reconstructed from the general advice to update pretrained components more slowly.
changes.new: Connector-only training leaves the original vision and language weights unchanged and avoids their weight gradients and optimizer state. It can still require LLM activations for input gradients. If the encoder output lacks the information needed for OCR, the projector cannot invent it; unfreezing vision allows those features to change. Changing the LLM can adapt how it uses visual inputs, but may degrade previous abilities. Retention must be measured on text-only and other preserved tasks, not inferred from the freeze schedule. ### InternVL 2.5: transferring the vision encoder [InternVL 2.5, §3.2 and Table 3](https://arxiv.org/html/2412.05271v1#S3.SS2) uses the same pre-training mixture in stages 1 and 1.5. What changes is which weights the next-token prediction loss can update. Stage 2 switches to curated multimodal instructions. | Stage | Updated | Frozen | | --- | --- | --- | | 1. Warmup | MLP | ViT, LLM | | 1.5. ViT | ViT, MLP | LLM | | 2. SFT | ViT, MLP, LLM | — | Take the car-color question again. In stage 1 the error on the answer backpropagates through the LLM to the projector: it can change the vectors the LLM receives, but not the features computed by the ViT. In stage 1.5, the ViT features can change too. The authors used that stage to adapt vision to domains such as multilingual OCR and charts without updating the language model. InternVL2.5-26B includes stage 1.5; 78B skips it. In [§3.3](https://arxiv.org/html/2412.05271v1#S3.SS3), the authors describe the transfer with 20B and 72B language models: adapt InternViT with the smaller LLM, then reuse those vision weights with the larger one. The new pair still needs stage 1 to fit the projector to the new LLM's input space. There is no separate encoder adaptation stage, but its weights are trainable again in stage 2. In [Zhe Chen et al., original Figure 4(b)](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2412.05271v1#page=6), the `shared weights` arrow starts at the ViT, not the projector. Molmo [§4](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.17146v2) skips connector-only warmup and trains all components directly on PixMo-Cap. The connector uses learning rate $2\cdot10^{-4}$ with 200 warmup steps, the ViT $6\cdot10^{-6}$ and the LLM $2\cdot10^{-5}$ with 2000 warmup steps each. InternVL 2.5 instead uses one learning rate across the model in stage 2. The freeze schedule and the learning rates are separate choices. ### InternVL 3 and 3.5: joint updates from the first stage [InternVL 3, §2.2](https://arxiv.org/html/2504.10479v1#S2.SS2) updates the ViT, projector and LLM together from the start of multimodal pre-training. Its mixture includes both text-only and multimodal examples. [InternVL 3.5, §§2.1–2.2](https://arxiv.org/html/2508.18265v1#S2.SS2) keeps this schedule. Both the vision encoder and language model start from pretrained weights. Here `native` describes when joint training starts, not random initialization. ![[02 Areas/ML & DL/00 Учебник/Assets/Figures/curated/vlm-training-2026-11-13/internvl35-training-process.png|Left to right: joint pre-training, SFT, and Cascade RL. The Flash variant adds ViCO to support different levels of visual compression.]] *Weiyun Wang et al., [InternVL3.5, Figure 3](https://arxiv.org/html/2508.18265v1#S2.F3), [original PNG](https://arxiv.org/html/2508.18265v1/training_process.png), [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Unmodified.* In the first block, the error on the car-color answer can already update all three components. Visual vectors still act as inputs. The model predicts text and, in dialogue examples, loss is applied to response tokens. In the second block, SFT keeps that objective and switches to curated conversations. The labels `250B tokens` and `130B tokens` count tokens at those two stages; Cascade RL's `270K samples` counts examples. The final ViCO block is for [[en/00 Textbook/16 Multimodal Models/64b Resolution, tiling, and spatial positions#vlm-internvl-resolution-router|the Flash variant with a resolution router]]. In the [InternVL 3 ablation, §3.14 and Figure 3](https://arxiv.org/html/2504.10479v1#S3.SS14), the authors kept the architecture, initialization, and training data of InternVL2-8B fixed and replaced MLP-only warmup with joint pre-training. On most of the benchmarks shown, pre-training alone gave results comparable to the full two-stage baseline. Instruction tuning improved them further. The ablation compares schedules for InternVL2-8B, not the performance of releases 2.5 and 3.5.
